attacks.name: Plasma Blast MK 2
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
During the |*Pay| |!power| |*Cost| step of this attack, this character may spend up to 2 additional |!power|. Add 1 die to the attack for each |!power| spent this way.

attacks.name: Suppression Protocols MK 2
steps: |!wild| |*Suppression|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§shock§Shock|, or |§slow§Slow|.

superPowers.name: Mutant Hunters (Affiliation: Sentinels)
superPowers.body: When an enemy character is Dazed or KO'd, after the effect is resolved, choose a number of allied characters up to that enemy character's |!threat|. Each chosen character gains 1 |!power|. A character cannot gain more than 1 |!power| as a result of this Leadership ability each Turn.

superPowers.name: Restraint Cables
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 4 and in LOS. Push the chosen character Toward this character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pattern Analysis
superPowers.body: While this character or an allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, that allied character may reroll 1 die in their roll. A character can reroll dice with this superpower only once per Turn

superPowers.name: Power Matrix
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's Activation, it gains 2 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Sentinel Programming
superPowers.body: This character cannot be Advanced or Pushed by |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers. When defending against |!mystic| attacks, this character counts |!wild| results in the defense roll as 2 successes.

erratas.body: Stamina decreased from 10 to 9 on Healthy side.
Stamina decreased from 8 to 7 on Injured side.
Plasma Blast MK 2 Strength increased from 5 to 6. Only 2 dice can be added by spending additional |!power| instead of 3.
Suppression Protocols MK 2: Strength decreased from 9 to 8. Power Cost decreased from 4 to 3. Range increased from 3 to 4.
Mutant Hunters Leadership now also applies to KOs.
Pattern Analysis now only allow each character to reroll dice once per turn.
Sentinel Programming: Allied superpower can now Advance or Push this character.
